name: Dakota Sunsets Campground
note: Each site is reached by an assigned color-coded entry and exit path shown on the operator's site guides, and the operator asks rigs to follow it because the turns are tight. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site dakotasunsets.com (read 2026-11-22, terms 'Last updated: September 5, 2026'; 'Dakota Sunsets uses a live reservation system through Campspot', phone (605) 705-3234, 25495 US-81, 1.5 mi north of I-90 exit 364) + Campspot API for park 4360 'Dakota Sunsets - Salem, SD' (Dakota Sunsets LLC), read 2026-11-22: 48 RV sites in five types (30A W/E 6, 30A FHU 14, 50A FHU 15+10, primitive 3) plus 5 tent sites, all sold by the night, one-night quotes available on every date read (May, Jun, Jul, Sep 2027 Tue+Sat and every month Nov 2026-Nov 2027), no minimum-stay or closure rule, no seasonal/monthly product; Motorhome Class C listed on every RV type, 30A W/E sites to 50 ft -> real transient RV park passing long-stay tests 2-5 (RV Life lists 55 sites, so ~48+ of ~55 are nightly). PRICE GATE PASS: cheapest electric RV night in season is the 30 Amp Water & Electric site, $45 base + $3 per-stay Reservation Fee = $48 for one night, 2 adults, Tue 2027-06-08; in winter (Oct 16-Mar 31, electric only) the same site is $27 + $3 = $30. Summer peak: 50A FHU for rigs over 40 ft $60 + $3. No gateway within 40 km (gateways.py); not a Good Sam Park (directory 2026-10-02 gs:false). Presence: own working website with phone + Campspot booking engine. Google Maps 4.7 on 560 reviews (gm.py 2026-11-22, place at 43.68878,-97.38999, phone +1 605-705-3234, open); RV Life 4.5*/$$$ on 461 ratings.
waterfront_evidence: 2026-11-22: Esri World Imagery crops (sat.py, both rendered) at 43.68868,-97.38882 (700 m frame) and 43.68870,-97.39020 (340 m frame). The campground is a rectangular shelterbelt-ringed block of gravel loops among cropland on the west side of US-81; the only water is a three-cell treatment lagoon (one open cell between two vegetated cells) at the park's west edge behind a track and trees, which the operator's rules name a restricted 'Water Treatment Zone/Lagoon'. No lake, river or creek in either frame -> not waterfront.
fees_source: Campspot API, park 4360 (campspot.com/book/dakota-sunsets), 2 adults, read 2026-11-22. In season (1-night quotes 2027-05-18/22, 06-08/12, 07-13/17, 09-14/18, all identical): Primitive Overnight Campspot (no hookups, to 50 ft, Motorhome Class C listed) $35; 30 Amp-Water & Electric $45; 30 Amp-Full Hookup $50; 50 Amp-Full Hookup (Rigs < 40ft) $55; 50 Amp-Full Hookup (Rigs > 40ft) $60; each plus a park 'Reservation Fee' $3 that is once per stay (2-night 30A W/E quote 2027-06-08: $90 + $3), plus tax (e.g. $2.74 on the $48 night). Winter: 1-night 30A W/E quotes 2027-01-19 ($45 less an automatic 'No Water, Restrooms, Laundry = ELECTRIC ONLY' discount of $18 = $27) and 2026-11-24 ($42.50 - $17 = $25.50); winter list averages (fee included) on 2027-01-19..03-31 and 10-16..11-16: primitive $24, 30A W/E $30, 30A FHU $33, 50A $36/$39, so primitive $21 and 50A-over-40ft $36 net of the $3 fee (derived from the list average, not a full quote). Season boundary from list prices: 2027-03-31 winter, 04-01 full; 10-15 full, 10-16 winter. Tent sites ($40 in season) not counted.
booking_source: https://dakotasunsets.com/ ('Book online through Campspot - instant confirmation, self-service check-in'; every Book Now links campspot.com/book/dakota-sunsets) and Campspot API park record 4360, read 2026-11-22; no minimum-stay rule returned on any date read
sites_source: Campspot API availability for park 4360, 2027-06-08, read 2026-11-22: 30 Amp-Full Hookup 14, 50 Amp-Full Hookup (>40ft) 10, 50 Amp-Full Hookup (<40ft) 15, 30 Amp-Water & Electric 6, Primitive Overnight Campspot 3, 20 Amp Private Tent Space 5 = 53 (the <40ft 50A type listed 16 on 2027-11-16; RV Life says 55)
hookups_source: Campspot site types read 2026-11-22 ('50 Amp-Full Hookup' x25 sites, '30 Amp-Full Hookup' x14, '30 Amp-Water & Electric' x6) and dakotasunsets.com ('50 Amp Power Hookup', 'Filtered Water Hookups', 'Sewer Hookups'), read 2026-11-22. Winter Oct 16-Mar 31 is electric only (no water).
facilities_source: https://dakotasunsets.com/ ('Our amenities include a laundry facility, free high-speed WiFi, a spacious picnic shelter, a dog park'), read 2026-11-22; showers, toilets and dump not stated, so left absent (restrooms exist per the winter discount line 'No Water, Restrooms, Laundry', type unstated)

season.note: Open all year; Oct 16 - Mar 31 sites are sold electric only, with no water, restrooms or laundry.

season_source: Campspot API park 4360, read 2026-11-22: every RV type bookable on dates in every month from 2026-11-24 to 2027-11-16, the only closure on record 2025-02-12..02-28; winter quotes carry the discount 'No Water, Restrooms, Laundry = ELECTRIC ONLY' from 10-16 to 03-31 (boundaries from list prices on 2027-03-31/04-01 and 2027-10-15/10-16)
flags: Price gate passes narrowly in season: $48 for one night on the cheapest electric site (30A water & electric, 6 sites), $45 site + $3 per-stay fee; it passes easily in winter ($30, electric only). Google 4.7 on 560 reviews, so not a borderline-quality drop candidate. RV Life tier is $$$ (avg $44).
fees.nightly_low 21 is the winter primitive (no-hookup) night, derived from Campspot's list average less the $3 per-stay fee, not a full price breakdown; the in-season primitive is $35 (quoted).

Discounts: Good Sam directory (2026-10-02) has it as gs:false (not a Good Sam Park), military:true; RV Life's affiliations list Good Sam, FMCA and AAA. No operator page names a Good Sam discount. Not written here; goodsam_discounts.py will derive it.

Operator's directions say the campground is 'on your right (east side of the road)' driving north on US-81, but imagery, the Campspot point (43.688681,-97.388824, the office) and Google's place all put it on the WEST side of US-81. Pin moved ~95 m west of the Campspot point to the middle of the loops.

Not a duplicate: no DB entry within 2 km or named Dakota Sunsets; the nearest entries are 5847 Montrose City Park and 5712 Lake Vermillion RA (both well over 2 km). Sister parks per the operator site: 5800 Betts Campground, Happy Campers (Chamberlain, lead 4), Valhalla Island (Lake Shetek MN).
